result.title: Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella's Conversation at Microsoft Build
result.description: At Microsoft Build, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang joined Microsoft chairman and CEO Satya Nadella's keynote via livestream from Taipei to discuss the expanded partnership: NVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Station for Windows, NVIDIA GPU-accelerated Microsoft Fabric, NVIDIA open models on Microsoft Foundry, the NVIDIA OpenShell secure runtime in GitHub Copilot and the next generation of NVIDIA-powered AI factories.

result.title: Peritas AI Showcase
result.description: Peritas AI, together with NVIDIA, is bringing data intelligence into the physical world with assistive humanoid robotics and real-time AI. The first deployment is at AdventHealth, focused on surgical workflows and enhancing the patient experience.

result.title: Introducing NVIDIA Cosmos 3: The Open Model That Thinks, Generates, and Acts
result.description:
For physical AI, compute is data.

NVIDIA Cosmos™ 3 is an open frontier omni-model for physical AI, built on a breakthrough mixture-of-transformers architecture. It reasons, generates, and acts — powering vision AI, synthetic data generation, closed-loop simulation, and world action models across robotics and autonomous vehicles.
Developers around the world are adopting Cosmos to build the age of physical AI.

result.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform Ramping into Full Production | Built for the Era of Agents
result.description:
A decade after NVIDIA DGX™-1, NVIDIA Vera Rubin redefines what an AI factory looks like. Built through extreme co-design, Vera Rubin unites trillions of transistors, modular compute, NVIDIA NVLink™, NVIDIA BlueField™, and silicon photonics into one unified platform—purpose-built for global-scale AI infrastructure. From model training to agentic AI workloads, Vera Rubin is the foundation for what comes next.

NVIDIA Vera Rubin is now in full production: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/vera-rubin-full-production-agentic-ai-factory

Learn more about the Vera Rubin platform: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/technologies/rubin/
